package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	AssessmentPurposeKnowledgeCheck = "knowledge_check"
	AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic     = "diagnostic"
)

func NormalizeAssessmentPurpose(raw string) (string, error) {
	value := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(raw))
	if value == "" {
		return AssessmentPurposeKnowledgeCheck, nil
	}
	if value != AssessmentPurposeKnowledgeCheck && value != AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	return value, nil
}

func AssessmentPurposeValue(raw string) string {
	if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
		return AssessmentPurposeKnowledgeCheck
	}
	return raw
}

const (
	// CodeStructureTypeTestSingleChoiceBasic — служебный тип структуры для задач-тестов с одним верным ответом.
	CodeStructureTypeTestSingleChoiceBasic = "TEST_SINGLE_CHOICE_BASIC"
	// CodeStructureTypeTestOrderingBasic — служебный тип структуры для задач на упорядочивание.
	CodeStructureTypeTestOrderingBasic = "TEST_ORDERING_BASIC"
	// CodeStructureTypeTestClassificationBasic — служебный тип структуры для задач на классификацию.
	CodeStructureTypeTestClassificationBasic = "TEST_CLASSIFICATION_BASIC"

	TaskTestKindSingleChoice   = "single_choice"
	TaskTestKindOrdering       = "ordering"
	TaskTestKindClassification = "classification"
)

var defaultTaskTestCodeStructures = map[string]json.RawMessage{
	TaskTestKindSingleChoice:   json.RawMessage(`{"test":{"mode":"single_choice"}}`),
	TaskTestKindOrdering:       json.RawMessage(`{"test":{"mode":"ordering"}}`),
	TaskTestKindClassification: json.RawMessage(`{"test":{"mode":"classification"}}`),
}

// DefaultTaskTestCodeStructure returns canonical code_structure for test tasks.
func DefaultTaskTestCodeStructure() json.RawMessage {
	return DefaultTaskAssessmentCodeStructure(TaskTestKindSingleChoice)
}

// DefaultTaskAssessmentCodeStructure returns canonical code_structure for an assessment kind.
func DefaultTaskAssessmentCodeStructure(kind string) json.RawMessage {
	raw := defaultTaskTestCodeStructures[kind]
	cloned := make([]byte, len(raw))
	copy(cloned, raw)
	return cloned
}

// TaskAssessmentKind maps a task type to the question kind stored for that task.
func TaskAssessmentKind(taskType int16) string {
	switch taskType {
	case TaskTypeTest:
		return TaskTestKindSingleChoice
	case TaskTypeOrdering:
		return TaskTestKindOrdering
	case TaskTypeClassification:
		return TaskTestKindClassification
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

// TaskAssessmentCodeStructureType maps a task type to its reference structure code.
func TaskAssessmentCodeStructureType(taskType int16) string {
	switch taskType {
	case TaskTypeTest:
		return CodeStructureTypeTestSingleChoiceBasic
	case TaskTypeOrdering:
		return CodeStructureTypeTestOrderingBasic
	case TaskTypeClassification:
		return CodeStructureTypeTestClassificationBasic
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

// IsAssessmentTaskType reports whether task data is stored in task_test tables.
func IsAssessmentTaskType(taskType int16) bool {
	return TaskAssessmentKind(taskType) != ""
}

// IsOfficialAutoScoredDiagnostic reports whether an assessment is eligible for
// the diagnostic catalog. The catalog contract intentionally requires the
// uppercase wire value AUTO rather than accepting another evaluation mode.
func IsOfficialAutoScoredDiagnostic(taskType int16, evaluationMode string) bool {
	return IsAssessmentTaskType(taskType) && evaluationMode == TaskEvaluationModeName(TaskEvaluationModeAuto)
}

// TaskTest represents one question inside test task.
type TaskTest struct {
	ID           string
	SourceKey    string
	TaskID       string
	Kind         string
	Title        string
	Description  string
	Translations []TaskTestI18n
	Groups       []TaskTestGroup
	Variants     []TaskTestVariant
	Order        int
	CreatedAt    time.Time
	UpdatedAt    time.Time
}

// TaskTestGroup represents one classification target group.
type TaskTestGroup struct {
	ID           string
	SourceKey    string
	TaskTestID   string
	Title        string
	Translations []TaskTestGroupI18n
	Order        int
	CreatedAt    time.Time
	UpdatedAt    time.Time
}

// TaskTestGroupI18n stores a localized classification group label.
type TaskTestGroupI18n struct {
	TaskTestGroupID string `json:"task_test_group_id"`
	I18nID          int    `json:"i18n_id"`
	Language        string `json:"lang"`
	Title           string `json:"title"`
}

// TaskTestI18n stores localized question title/description.
type TaskTestI18n struct {
	TaskTestID  string `json:"task_test_id"`
	I18nID      int    `json:"i18n_id"`
	Language    string `json:"lang"`
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

// TaskTestVariant represents one answer option inside a test question.
type TaskTestVariant struct {
	ID             string
	SourceKey      string
	TaskTestID     string
	Text           string
	IsCorrect      bool
	CorrectOrder   *int
	GroupID        string
	GroupSourceKey string
	Translations   []TaskTestVariantI18n
	Order          int
	CreatedAt      time.Time
	UpdatedAt      time.Time
}

// TaskTestVariantI18n stores localized answer option text.
type TaskTestVariantI18n struct {
	TaskTestVariantID string `json:"task_test_variant_id"`
	I18nID            int    `json:"i18n_id"`
	Language          string `json:"lang"`
	Text              string `json:"text"`
}

// ValidateTaskTests validates test configuration for one test task.
func ValidateTaskTests(tests []TaskTest, allowedErrorsCount int) error {
	return ValidateTaskAssessments(tests, allowedErrorsCount, TaskTestKindSingleChoice)
}

// ValidateTaskAssessments validates questions for one assessment task.
func ValidateTaskAssessments(tests []TaskTest, allowedErrorsCount int, expectedKind string) error {
	switch expectedKind {
	case TaskTestKindSingleChoice, TaskTestKindOrdering, TaskTestKindClassification:
	default:
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if len(tests) == 0 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if allowedErrorsCount < 0 || allowedErrorsCount >= len(tests) {
		return ErrValidation
	}

	questionOrders := make(map[int]struct{}, len(tests))
	for _, test := range tests {
		if test.Kind != expectedKind {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		if test.Order <= 0 {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := questionOrders[test.Order]; exists {
			return ErrConflict
		}
		questionOrders[test.Order] = struct{}{}
		if len(test.Translations) == 0 {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		hasQuestionTitle := false
		for _, translation := range test.Translations {
			if translation.I18nID <= 0 {
				return ErrValidation
			}
			if strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title) != "" {
				hasQuestionTitle = true
			}
		}
		if !hasQuestionTitle {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		maxVariants := 50
		if expectedKind == TaskTestKindSingleChoice {
			maxVariants = 5
		}
		if len(test.Variants) < 2 || len(test.Variants) > maxVariants {
			return ErrValidation
		}

		groupIDs := make(map[string]int, len(test.Groups))
		groupKeys := make(map[string]int, len(test.Groups))
		groupOrders := make(map[int]struct{}, len(test.Groups))
		if expectedKind == TaskTestKindClassification {
			if len(test.Groups) < 2 || len(test.Groups) > 20 {
				return ErrValidation
			}
			for groupIndex, group := range test.Groups {
				if group.Order <= 0 || len(group.Translations) == 0 {
					return ErrValidation
				}
				if _, exists := groupOrders[group.Order]; exists {
					return ErrConflict
				}
				groupOrders[group.Order] = struct{}{}
				if group.ID != "" {
					groupIDs[group.ID] = groupIndex
				}
				if group.SourceKey != "" {
					groupKeys[group.SourceKey] = groupIndex
				}
				hasTitle := false
				for _, translation := range group.Translations {
					if translation.I18nID <= 0 {
						return ErrValidation
					}
					if strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title) != "" {
						hasTitle = true
					}
				}
				if !hasTitle {
					return ErrValidation
				}
			}
		} else if len(test.Groups) != 0 {
			return ErrValidation
		}

		variantOrders := make(map[int]struct{}, len(test.Variants))
		correctOrders := make(map[int]struct{}, len(test.Variants))
		usedGroups := make(map[int]struct{}, len(test.Groups))
		correctCount := 0
		for _, variant := range test.Variants {
			if variant.Order <= 0 {
				return ErrValidation
			}
			if _, exists := variantOrders[variant.Order]; exists {
				return ErrConflict
			}
			variantOrders[variant.Order] = struct{}{}
			if variant.IsCorrect {
				correctCount++
			}
			switch expectedKind {
			case TaskTestKindSingleChoice:
				if variant.CorrectOrder != nil || variant.GroupID != "" || variant.GroupSourceKey != "" {
					return ErrValidation
				}
			case TaskTestKindOrdering:
				if variant.IsCorrect || variant.CorrectOrder == nil || *variant.CorrectOrder <= 0 || *variant.CorrectOrder > len(test.Variants) || variant.GroupID != "" || variant.GroupSourceKey != "" {
					return ErrValidation
				}
				if _, exists := correctOrders[*variant.CorrectOrder]; exists {
					return ErrConflict
				}
				correctOrders[*variant.CorrectOrder] = struct{}{}
			case TaskTestKindClassification:
				if variant.IsCorrect || variant.CorrectOrder != nil {
					return ErrValidation
				}
				groupIndexByID, validID := groupIDs[variant.GroupID]
				groupIndexByKey, validKey := groupKeys[variant.GroupSourceKey]
				if !validID && !validKey {
					return ErrValidation
				}
				if validID && validKey && groupIndexByID != groupIndexByKey {
					return ErrValidation
				}
				groupIndex := groupIndexByID
				if validKey {
					groupIndex = groupIndexByKey
				}
				usedGroups[groupIndex] = struct{}{}
			}
			if len(variant.Translations) == 0 {
				return ErrValidation
			}
			hasVariantText := false
			for _, translation := range variant.Translations {
				if translation.I18nID <= 0 {
					return ErrValidation
				}
				if strings.TrimSpace(translation.Text) != "" {
					hasVariantText = true
				}
			}
			if !hasVariantText {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		}
		switch expectedKind {
		case TaskTestKindSingleChoice:
			if correctCount != 1 {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		case TaskTestKindOrdering:
			if len(correctOrders) != len(test.Variants) {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		case TaskTestKindClassification:
			for groupIndex := range test.Groups {
				if _, used := usedGroups[groupIndex]; !used {
					return ErrValidation
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return nil
}
